rv.q: Comedy is commentary, so if you haven't decided where to point, there's no reason for us to laugh.
Though the storyline is new, Friends! The Musical Parody still incorporates highlights from the show's 10 seasons, including iconic lines, jokes, and references.
The couple who describe themselves as “huggable weirdos who met at a Girl Scout Cookie Convention” has given us an irresistibly hilarious night of comedy.
Trust me, folks, it's a really fun night.
'Friends!' will make you laugh so hard your face will hurt, your eyes will tear, and you'll be ready to come back.
This is a fun night out for any fan – casual or dedicated.
Skillfully directed, 'Friends! The Musical Parody' is an entertaining trip down memory lane.
While those unacquainted with the world of Friends are unlikely to enjoy, fans with even a general knowledge of the series’ running jokes will find something to love about this hilarious parody.
If you like the Friends TV show, you will probably enjoy Friends the Musical.
The show manages to pay homage to a classic TV show which is probably all you can ask for.
